corrections.text: The article gives the 1.25 times (30-minute) and 2.5 times (12-hour) cache-write rates without naming the models. OpenAI's guide states these rates and the prompt_cache_options.ttl setting for GPT-5.6 and later; for earlier models its model-comparison table lists "No additional cache-write charge" and a different control, prompt_cache_retention.

The article does not state when OpenAI's changelog and prompt caching guide were retrieved. Both are live documentation pages whose rates and wording may change; they were reviewed on October 26, 2026.
